request.state: Synthetic invoice INV-100: total USD 80.00; payment status PAID; outstanding balance USD 0.00. It was paid in full before its due date. Use these rules: amounts strictly greater than USD 1000 exceed the review threshold; paid invoices need no collection action; unpaid invoices before their due date need routine collection; overdue unpaid invoices need urgent collection.

payment_status.instructions: Classify the invoice's current payment status.

over_review_threshold.instructions: Is the invoice total strictly greater than USD 1000?

collection_urgency.instructions: Apply the collection rules to select the urgency level.
criteria: No collection action: the invoice is paid in full.
Routine collection: the invoice is unpaid and not overdue.
Urgent collection: the invoice is unpaid and overdue.
